subtitle: Lesson 20 · Teleportation & Superdense Coding in Practice

eyebrow: Three qubits, one shared Bell pair
caption: q2,q3 pre-entangled. Alice runs CNOT then H on her two qubits, and sends c1, c2 classically.

eyebrow: The correction table, with real numbers (a=0.8, b=0.6)
code:
Alice measures   Bob's raw amps    correction
00                (0.4, 0.3)         I
01                (0.3, 0.4)         X
10                (0.4, -0.3)        Z
11                (-0.3, 0.4)        X then Z

all four, after correction  ->  (0.8, 0.6) = |psi>
caption: Every branch, once corrected, lands exactly on the original state.

steps.label: Not faster-than-light signaling
steps.sub: Bob's four possible pre-correction states are physically different

steps.label: He needs Alice's two classical bits
steps.sub: Those bits travel at or below light speed, like any ordinary message

steps.label: What crosses is the information describing |ψ⟩
steps.sub: Not a particle, not energy, and not a copy

steps.label: Alice's original qubit is destroyed the instant she measures
steps.sub: The superposition a|0⟩+b|1⟩ no longer exists anywhere on her side

subtitle: Running the idea in the opposite direction: one qubit carrying two classical bits.
